high.title: Foreign Investors Net Sold Over 1 Trillion VND in Two Major Stocks During Week Index Hits Historic High
high.summary: Vietnamese stock market delivered strong performance during May 4-8 trading week. VN-Index oscillated around 1,855 points from the opening session and maintained strong buying pressure in blue-chip stocks throughout the week. Particularly, increased demand on May 7 helped the Index establish a new all-time high. The VN-Index closed the week up 54.91 points (+2.96%) to 1,915.37 points with average daily trading value reaching nearly 19 trillion VND. However, foreign investors were a major drag, net selling heavily throughout early May sessions. After 5 sessions, foreign investors net sold 4,158 billion VND across the entire market - 4,351 billion VND on HoSE, net bought 256 billion VND on HNX, and net sold 63 billion VND on UPCoM. This massive foreign outflow despite record index levels signals potential pressure on VND demand and suggests institutional investors may be taking profits at these elevated valuations.

high.title: Securities Market Hits New High, Brokerage Names 5 Stock Groups with Money-Attracting Opportunities This Month
high.summary: SHS Securities reports VN-Index performance in April 2026 closely followed their base scenario from 2026 strategy report. Led by large-cap stocks, especially sector leaders, the market recovered strongly and returned to 1,900 points. For May, market focus shifts to April macroeconomic data including inflation, trade balance, and PMI to reflect Middle East conflict impacts on businesses and economy. SHS notes ongoing global geopolitical tensions, slowing credit growth, energy crisis, and rising inflation/cost pressures beginning to significantly impact enterprises and economy. Margin lending remains at high levels. Key upcoming macro data releases will be crucial for assessing inflationary pressures and their impact on SBV monetary policy stance, particularly relevant for VND stability and government bond yields.

medium.title: PYN Elite Fund Issues Important Announcement: 28,000 Billion Scale "Shark" Holding Sacombank, Hoa Phat, Mobile World Shares
medium.summary: PYN Elite Fund reported +1% performance in April 2026 while VN-Index gained 10.7%. Notable April event was FTSE's official confirmation of Vietnam's upgrade from frontier to secondary emerging market status, implemented in 4 phases from September 2026 to September 2027. This milestone, combined with positive Q1 earnings, supported the market with listed companies posting 36% net profit growth YoY.

medium.title: One Bank to Pay Nearly 5,000 Billion VND Cash Dividend
medium.summary: Techcombank (TCB) announced 7% cash dividend for 2025 (700 VND/share), totaling over 4,960 billion VND. Final registration date is May 20, 2026, with payment expected June 10, 2026. This marks the third consecutive year of cash dividend payments, with plans for additional 60% stock dividend in 2026.

medium.title: Three Banks Want to List on HOSE This Year
medium.summary: VietBank (VBB) completed documentation for HOSE listing in March 2026 with nearly 1.1 billion shares. Due to geopolitical uncertainties and financial market volatility, the bank will choose an appropriate timing for official listing, expected in Q2 or Q3 2026. The move aims to enhance prestige, transparency, and brand positioning while expanding access to institutional and retail investors.

medium.title: Many Large Private Banks Saw Deposit Declines of Tens of Trillions VND in First Quarter
medium.summary: Among 27 listed banks, total customer deposits reached 12.88 million billion VND at end-Q1 2026, up 0.6% from end-2025. However, 12 banks experienced deposit declines. BIDV led with 82,031 billion VND decline (-3.7%), followed by MB with 15,450 billion VND drop (-1.7%). Several major private banks including Techcombank also saw deposit outflows, indicating potential liquidity pressures in the banking system.
